Flow.description: Books PD SOM (60 min) or Follow-up (30 min) calls. Uses weighted round-robin for first PD assignment, sticky routing for follow-ups.

formulas.name: pdEmailBody
formulas.expression:
"

Hi " & {!Get_Primary_Contact.Contact.FirstName} & ",

Thank you for choosing Zenith Prep Academy! We're excited to connect you with your dedicated Program Director for a strategy planning session.

This meeting is an opportunity to discuss your student's goals, map out a personalized plan, and answer any questions you may have. We want to make sure you are able to get started as soon as possible, so keep in mind that only one parent needs to attend (though more are always welcome!), and students are optional but encouraged if available.

Please use the scheduling link below to choose a meeting time that works best for your family's schedule:

Schedule Your PD Meeting

This meeting will be approximately 60 minutes via Zoom. Your Program Director will be your student's primary strategist and point of contact throughout the program.

Looking forward to getting started!

Best,
Zenith Prep Academy

"

formulas.name: fssEmailBody
formulas.expression:
"

Hi " & {!Get_Primary_Contact.Contact.FirstName} & ",

I know I speak for our entire team when I say that we're very excited to have your family be part of our college consulting program and are looking forward to seeing all that we'll be able to achieve together.

The next step is to schedule your Onboarding Meeting with one of our Family Success Specialists (FSS) over Zoom. This meeting is a chance for us to get to know your family, explore available resources, and ensure you feel supported every step of the way. We want to make sure you are able to get started as soon as possible, so keep in mind that only one parent needs to attend (though more are always welcome!), and students are optional but encouraged if available.

Please use the scheduling link below to choose a meeting time that works best for your family's schedule:

Schedule Your Onboarding Meeting

Once you've selected a time, your assigned FSS will follow up to confirm your appointment within 24-36 hours and introduce themselves. Your FSS will be your family's advocate and partner throughout this process. They will be with your family from the first Onboarding Meeting through any major decisions or hurdles to make sure your family has support that reflects our highest standard of professional quality.

After the initial onboarding meeting, the FSS will coordinate with our leadership team to connect your family to your student's team, including their Educational Strategist, and they will be reaching out within 24 hours to set up the initial strategy meeting.

Looking forward to having your family as part of our Zenith family.

Best,
Zenith Prep Academy

"

formulas.name: pdSubject
formulas.expression: IF({!varIsFollowUp}, "Program Director Follow Up - Zenith Prep Academy", "Program Director - 60 Minutes - Zenith Prep Academy")
